Eight days, seven nights

The day-by-day plan.

One Havelock base for three nights keeps the water activities simple. Return to Port Blair the day before flying.

The overall allowance
₹2.90 lakh
₹58,000 per person

₹20,000 each already spent on flights, plus ₹38,000 each for stays, ferries, experiences, food and a buffer.

Spend on the underwater experience. Keep hotels comfortable and practical, use standard ferry seats and share one suitable vehicle.

The ₹60,000-per-person ceiling leaves ₹10,000 for the group beyond this plan. Confirm hotel totals before paying for activities. An Elephant Beach excursion with a paid longer snorkel would cost more than the dedicated reef snorkel here.

Ross is not a confirmed booking. If added, its tickets and transfers must fit the contingency or be priced separately. Unused contingency is savings, not a spending target.

Haddo or a central base

Hotel De Pebbles ↗Practical for Haddo ferry terminal; a double plus a true triple room may work. Reuse the hotel on the return night if the quote suits.

Havelock · 3 nights

Govind / Vijay Nagar

13–16 Dec · unbooked

Blue Bird Resort ↗Beach 5 area, nearby food options and short activity transfers. Not beachfront. Its direct-booking offer advertises jetty transfers; get them in writing.

Neil · 1 night

Neil Kendra / Bharatpur

16–17 Dec · unbooked

CS Empire · review carefully ↗Useful central area, with published three-guest rooms. Recent review scores vary considerably; inspect current room reviews before selecting it.

Alternative: Pearl Park ↗Sunset-area resort option. Published peak surcharge applies from 15 Dec; only consider if the complete quote fits and cancellation terms are acceptable.

Quote one double and one room for three adults with an extra bed or mattress, breakfast for all five, all taxes, peak supplements and cancellation terms. The Havelock stay includes the night of 15 Dec, when some properties start peak-season pricing.

The priorities

Make the experiences count.

Book the format and inclusions by name. A short complimentary trial snorkel is different from a longer guided reef session.

01

Beginner boat scuba

₹5,000 each allowance · Target a 40-minute Juvis Reef session with training, equipment and guide. Certification is not required for the beginner experience. Reef and departure depend on conditions.

02

Guided boat snorkelling

₹2,000 each allowance · Target 30 minutes at Tribe Gate, with guide and equipment. Confirm transport, boat, media and the five-person group arrangement.

03

Pre-dawn bioluminescence kayak

₹2,500 each allowance · Target 90 minutes, around 03:30–05:00. A guided night-water experience; visible glow is a possibility, not a promise. Confirm the exact pickup and launch area.

04

Baratang mangroves + caves

₹15,000 group allowance · One SUV for five, convoy logistics, vehicle ferry, creek boat and cave access. Ask for every inclusion; this is a full early-start day.

Seahawks is a researched activity candidate, not a confirmed provider. Dive menu ↗ · Snorkel / kayak menu ↗. Prices are published references and planning allowances; verify final group quotes and weather policies.

Decide on arrival

Keep these flexible, according to the weather, tide and everyone’s energy.

  1. Extra local cabs and meal placesArrange additional point-to-point rides and choose restaurants locally. The arrival airport pickup, Baratang and major transfers should already be arranged.
    Flexible
  2. 11 Dec · arrange daytime Cellular Jail entryDaytime entry is separate from the light-and-sound show. Arrange entry on arrival if the flight leaves enough time; verify the day’s entry hours. Official details ↗.
    On arrival
  3. Free beach visits and Natural Bridge guideAdjust the order of beaches on the day. Check daylight low tide before visiting Natural Bridge; decide locally whether to hire an optional guide.
    Tide / weather
  4. Souvenir shoppingChoose what to buy at Sagarika or Aberdeen Bazaar, with the group’s ₹5,000 shopping allowance in mind.
    Flexible
  5. 17 Dec · decide on optional Ross IslandDecide only after the actual Port Blair ferry arrival and a suitable same-day return boat are confirmed. If the timing is tight, keep the afternoon for shopping or the jail.
    Optional
